title: Subtraction Fact Strategies Within 20
description: Practice counting back, counting up to find a difference, making 10, using addition, and choosing a helpful subtraction strategy within 20.
learningFocus: Use counting back, counting up, making 10, and related addition facts to subtract within 20 and explain a helpful strategy.
adultGuidance: Have your child show or explain how a strategy works, and accept any clear strategy that produces the correct difference. Finger counting is welcome; complete pages 3 and 4 in order because the first practices reaching 10 and the next adds the remaining subtraction step.
